task.title: Fix the shared-work-branch false positive in enforce-allowed-paths.mjs and scope-expansion-gate.mjs

problem.statement: enforce-allowed-paths.mjs and scope-expansion-gate.mjs both computed a task's changed files as `git diff source.baseSha...HEAD`, which is only accurate when the task's repair runs on an isolated child branch created at baseSha. Discovered while closing GAP-0003 (iteration 2): because tasks were repaired directly on the shared work branch (no per-task branch automation exists yet outside the human-gated Agent Controller), every unrelated commit landed on the branch since baseSha showed up as a false OUTSIDE_ALLOWED_PATHS / scope-expansion violation (13 false violations were observed for GAP-0003's single-file repair).

evidence.note: observation.unexpectedResults documents the 13 false OUTSIDE_ALLOWED_PATHS violations discovered while closing GAP-0003.
Formerly computed changed files exclusively via changedFiles(contract.source.baseSha), i.e. git diff baseSha...HEAD.
Formerly computed changed files exclusively via changedFilesSince(contract.source.baseSha), the same commit-range assumption.

rootCauseHypothesis: Both tools assumed the childBranchPattern in progressive-remediation-policy.json (task/<work-branch>/<task-id>-<slug>) was always used, but that branch automation is still human-gated (wave P0-E's Agent Controller role) and was not used for any task closed so far in this session; every task ran directly on the shared work branch reemsam, so a commit-range diff picks up unrelated, already-committed work from other closed tasks.

current: A task's scope check false-positives whenever any other commit lands on the shared work branch after its baseSha, even if that commit belongs to a different, already-closed task.
required: Both tools prefer the executor's self-declared execution.changedPaths (the union across all of a task's iteration records) as the scope-check source of truth, falling back to the baseSha...HEAD git diff only when no iteration has run yet for that task.
forbidden: Silencing the false positive by weakening or removing the scope check instead of fixing its diff basis.
Requiring per-task branch isolation as a precondition for this fix (branch automation remains a separate, larger, human-gated undertaking).

acceptance.statement: enforce-allowed-paths.mjs and scope-expansion-gate.mjs both prefer a task's recorded execution.changedPaths over a baseSha...HEAD commit-range diff whenever iteration records exist.
Running enforce-allowed-paths.mjs against GAP-0003's completed contract (the task that originally surfaced the 13 false violations) now passes with zero violations.
guard:scope-expansion still fails closed with BASE_SHA_UNREACHABLE for a task with no iteration records and an unreachable baseSha (the pre-existing fallback path is preserved).
